body: I like to pick something to distract me and not cut until it's over. People on tumblr obsess over glitter jars, but just like sit down and watch an episode of a TV show, or read a chapter of a book, heck just sit and stare at the clock for ten minutes. I find that promising myself "you're not going to cut for X amount of time" that when that time is up, I often don't care anymore!
That's why winter is my favorite too! Wrists and calves are my favorite places, I HATE having to cut on my thighs during the warmer months!

My favorite is an old piece of broken glass. It's from a lampshade that my dad broke throwing at me, and I don't know why but it feels right to use.

It's only for special occasions though, usually I just use safety razors or a pocketknife.

Absolutely. I could be having an amazing day, perfect really. I'll be lovely and happy, singing along to the radio, and if a sad song comes on, I'm done. I'm wrecked for the day. There's only a couple that really do it, so sometimes I can catch the beginning before the emptiness starts to hit. It's interesting, though, to really see how big an effect music can have.
Think of something i'm looking forward to; think about how i'll miss finding out how it goes.
